import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
import 'package:profil_Smile/screens/order_details_screen.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:firebase_core/firebase_core.dart';
import 'package:firebase_messaging/firebase_messaging.dart';

import 'firebase_options.dart';
import 'core/localization/app_localizations.dart';
import 'core/services/api_service.dart';
import 'core/services/notification_service.dart';
import 'providers/locale_provider.dart';
import 'screens/splash_screen.dart';

// Key للوصول إلى ScaffoldMessenger لإظهار SnackBar
final GlobalKey<ScaffoldMessengerState> adminMessengerKey =
    GlobalKey<ScaffoldMessengerState>();

// Key للتحكم بالتنقل Navigator بدون الحاجة لـ BuildContext
final GlobalKey<NavigatorState> navigatorKey = GlobalKey<NavigatorState>();

@pragma('vm:entry-point')
Future<void> _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler(RemoteMessage message) async {
  await Firebase.initializeApp(options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform);
}

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  await Firebase.initializeApp(options: DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform);

  FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage(_firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler);

  final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
  final String? savedToken = prefs.getString('auth_token');

  // ✅ تحميل الإشعارات المخزّنة مسبقاً
  await NotificationService.loadNotifications();

  // ✅ تهيئة مستمعي إشعارات Firebase (foreground + openedApp)
  NotificationService.initializeListeners();

  // ✅ معالجة الإشعار الذي فتح التطبيق من حالة مغلقة (terminated)
  final RemoteMessage? initialMessage = await FirebaseMessaging.instance
      .getInitialMessage();
  if (initialMessage != null) {
    await NotificationService.addFromRemoteMessage(initialMessage);
  }

  await _setupAdminFCM();

  runApp(
    ChangeNotifierProvider(
      create: (_) => LocaleProvider(),
      child: const MyApp(),
    ),
  );
}

Future<void> _sendFcmTokenToBackend(String token) async {
  try {
    final response = await ApiService.post('/update-fcm-token', {
      'fcm_token': token,
    });
  } catch (e) {}
}

Future<void> _setupAdminFCM() async {
  FirebaseMessaging messaging = FirebaseMessaging.instance;

  NotificationSettings settings = await messaging.requestPermission(
    alert: true,
    badge: true,
    sound: true,
  );

  if (settings.authorizationStatus == AuthorizationStatus.authorized) {
    String? fcmToken = await messaging.getToken();
    if (fcmToken != null) {
      await _sendFcmTokenToBackend(fcmToken);
    }

    messaging.onTokenRefresh.listen((newToken) async {
      await _sendFcmTokenToBackend(newToken);
    });

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
    // إشعارات أثناء تشغيل التطبيق (foreground)
    // - تُحفظ في Service
    // - يُظهر SnackBar (النص بلغة المستخدم القادم من السيرفر)
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
    FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen((RemoteMessage message) {
      // 1. حفظ الإشعار في القائمة المحلية
      NotificationService.addFromRemoteMessage(message);

      // 2. عرض SnackBar مباشرة (النص جاهز بلغة المستخدم)
      final title = message.notification?.title ?? '';
      final body = message.notification?.body ?? '';

      if (title.isEmpty && body.isEmpty) return;

      adminMessengerKey.currentState?.showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              if (title.isNotEmpty)
                Text(
                  title,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    fontSize: 14,
                  ),
                ),
              if (body.isNotEmpty) ...[
                if (title.isNotEmpty) const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(body, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13)),
              ],
            ],
          ),
          backgroundColor: Colors.blueAccent,
          duration: const Duration(seconds: 4),
          behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        ),
      );
    });

    // ✅ معالجة الضغط على الإشعار أثناء تشغيل التطبيق في الخلفية
    FirebaseMessaging.onMessageOpenedApp.listen((RemoteMessage message) {
      // حفظ الإشعار في القائمة أيضاً
      NotificationService.addFromRemoteMessage(message);

      if (message.data.containsKey('order_id')) {
        final int? orderId = int.tryParse(message.data['order_id'].toString());

        if (orderId != null) {
          navigatorKey.currentState?.push(
            MaterialPageRoute(
              builder: (context) => OrderDetailsScreen(orderId: orderId),
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    });
  } else {}
}

class MyApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const MyApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final localeProvider = Provider.of<LocaleProvider>(context);

    return MaterialApp(
      navigatorKey: navigatorKey,
      scaffoldMessengerKey: adminMessengerKey,
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      title: 'Smile Lab Admin',
      locale: localeProvider.locale ?? const Locale('ar'),
      supportedLocales: LocaleProvider.supportedLocales,
      localizationsDelegates: const [
        AppLocalizations.delegate,
        GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
        GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
        GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
      ],
      home: const SplashScreen(),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:easy_localization/easy_localization.dart'; // أو الحزمة التي تستخدمها للترجمة

extension OrderStatusExtension on String {
  /// تحويل حالة الطلب القادمة من API إلى نص مترجم بحسب لغة التطبيق
  String toTranslatedStatus(BuildContext context) {
    final cleanStatus = trim().toLowerCase();

    switch (cleanStatus) {
      case 'received':
        return 'received'.tr();
      case 'in_production':
      case 'in-production':
        return 'in_production'.tr();
      case 'pending':
        return 'pending'.tr();
      case 'delivered':
        return 'delivered'.tr();
      case 'approved':
        return 'approved'.tr();
      case 'needs_redo':
        return 'needs_redo'.tr();
      default:
        return this; // في حال كانت حالة غير معروفة
    }
  }
}



// ==================================
// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\core\localization\app_localizations.dart
// ==================================
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

class AppLocalizations {
  final Locale locale;
  late Map<String, String> _localizedStrings;

  AppLocalizations(this.locale);

  static AppLocalizations? of(BuildContext context) {
    return Localizations.of<AppLocalizations>(context, AppLocalizations);
  }

  static const LocalizationsDelegate<AppLocalizations> delegate =
      _AppLocalizationsDelegate();

  Future<bool> load() async {
    try {
      String jsonString = await rootBundle.loadString(
        'assets/i18n/${locale.languageCode}.json',
      );
      Map<String, dynamic> jsonMap = json.decode(jsonString);

      _localizedStrings = jsonMap.map((key, value) {
        return MapEntry(key, value.toString());
      });
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      _localizedStrings = {};
      return false;
    }
  }

  String translate(String key) {
    return _localizedStrings[key] ?? key;
  }

  /// ترجمة نصوص تحتوي على متغيرات مثل {name} و {count}
  String translateWithArgs(String key, Map<String, String> args) {
    String text = translate(key);
    args.forEach((k, v) {
      text = text.replaceAll('{$k}', v);
    });
    return text;
  }

  bool get isRTL => locale.languageCode == 'ar';
}

class _AppLocalizationsDelegate
    extends LocalizationsDelegate<AppLocalizations> {
  const _AppLocalizationsDelegate();

  @override
  bool isSupported(Locale locale) {
    return ['ar', 'en', 'de'].contains(locale.languageCode);
  }

  @override
  Future<AppLocalizations> load(Locale locale) async {
    AppLocalizations localizations = AppLocalizations(locale);
    await localizations.load();
    return localizations;
  }

  @override
  bool shouldReload(_AppLocalizationsDelegate old) => false;
}



// ==================================
// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\core\services\api_service.dart
// ==================================
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../constants/api_constants.dart'; // تأكد من استيراد كلاس الثوابت الخاص بك

class ApiService {
  // بناء الرابط الكامل سواء تم تمرير رابط كامل أو مسار نسبي
  static Uri _buildUri(String url) {
    if (url.startsWith('http://') || url.startsWith('https://')) {
      return Uri.parse(url);
    }
    // دمج BaseURL مع المسار النسبي
    final baseUrl = ApiConstants.baseUrl.endsWith('/')
        ? ApiConstants.baseUrl.substring(0, ApiConstants.baseUrl.length - 1)
        : ApiConstants.baseUrl;
    final path = url.startsWith('/') ? url : '/$url';
    return Uri.parse('$baseUrl$path');
  }

  // تجميع الهيدرز المطلوبة والتأكد من إرفاق التوكين
  static Future<Map<String, String>> _getHeaders() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final token =
        prefs.getString('auth_token') ?? prefs.getString('token') ?? '';

    return {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Accept': 'application/json',
      if (token.isNotEmpty) 'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
    };
  }

  // طلب POST
  static Future<http.Response> post(
    String url,
    Map<String, dynamic> body,
  ) async {
    final headers = await _getHeaders();
    return await http.post(
      _buildUri(url),
      headers: headers,
      body: jsonEncode(body),
    );
  }

  // طلب GET
  static Future<http.Response> get(String url) async {
    final headers = await _getHeaders();
    return await http.get(_buildUri(url), headers: headers);
  }

  // طلب PUT
  static Future<http.Response> put(
    String url,
    Map<String, dynamic> body,
  ) async {
    final headers = await _getHeaders();
    return await http.put(
      _buildUri(url),
      headers: headers,
      body: jsonEncode(body),
    );
  }

  // طلب DELETE
  static Future<http.Response> delete(String url) async {
    final headers = await _getHeaders();
    return await http.delete(_buildUri(url), headers: headers);
  }
}



// ==================================
// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\core\services\notification_service.dart
// ==================================
import 'package:firebase_messaging/firebase_messaging.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../../models/notification_model.dart';

// دالة التعامل مع الإشعارات في الخلفية (Top-Level Function)
@pragma('vm:entry-point')
Future<void> _firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler(RemoteMessage message) async {
  await NotificationService.addFromRemoteMessage(message);
}

class NotificationService {
  static const String _storageKey = 'app_notifications';
  static const int _maxStoredNotifications = 100;

  /// عدّاد الإشعارات غير المقروءة (للتحديث المباشر للواجهة)
  static final ValueNotifier<int> unreadCountNotifier = ValueNotifier<int>(0);

  /// قائمة الإشعارات الكاملة (للاستماع المباشر)
  static final ValueNotifier<List<AppNotification>> notificationsNotifier =
      ValueNotifier<List<AppNotification>>([]);

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // تهيئة الخدمة والمستمعات (تُستدعى في main.dart)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> initialize() async {
    // 1. تحميل الإشعارات المخزنة سابقاً
    await loadNotifications();

    // 2. طلب صلاحيات الإشعار لأجهزة iOS و Android 13+
    await FirebaseMessaging.instance.requestPermission(
      alert: true,
      badge: true,
      sound: true,
    );

    // 3. ضبط خيارات إظهار الإشعار أثناء فتح التطبيق (Foreground Heads-up)
    await FirebaseMessaging.instance
        .setForegroundNotificationPresentationOptions(
          alert: true,
          badge: true,
          sound: true,
        );

    // 4. تسجيل مستمع الإشعارات في الخلفية
    FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage(_firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler);

    // 5. تهيئة مستمعي الواجهة (Foreground & Opened)
    initializeListeners();
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // تحميل الإشعارات من التخزين المحلي
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<List<AppNotification>> loadNotifications() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final raw = prefs.getString(_storageKey);
    if (raw == null || raw.isEmpty) {
      notificationsNotifier.value = [];
      unreadCountNotifier.value = 0;
      return [];
    }
    final list = AppNotification.decodeList(raw);
    list.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.compareTo(a.createdAt));
    notificationsNotifier.value = list;
    unreadCountNotifier.value = list.where((n) => !n.isRead).length;
    return list;
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // إضافة إشعار جديد
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> addNotification(AppNotification notification) async {
    final current = notificationsNotifier.value;
    // تجنّب التكرار
    if (current.any((n) => n.id == notification.id)) return;

    final updated = [notification, ...current];
    if (updated.length > _maxStoredNotifications) {
      updated.removeRange(_maxStoredNotifications, updated.length);
    }
    await _save(updated);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // إضافة إشعار من FCM
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> addFromRemoteMessage(RemoteMessage message) async {
    final map = <String, dynamic>{
      'messageId': message.messageId,
      'notification': message.notification != null
          ? {
              'title': message.notification!.title,
              'body': message.notification!.body,
            }
          : null,
      'data': message.data,
    };

    final notification = AppNotification.fromRemoteMessage(map);
    await addNotification(notification);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // تحديد كمقروء
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> markAsRead(String id) async {
    final updated = notificationsNotifier.value.map((n) {
      if (n.id == id) n.isRead = true;
      return n;
    }).toList();
    await _save(updated);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // تحديد الكل كمقروء
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> markAllAsRead() async {
    final updated = notificationsNotifier.value.map((n) {
      n.isRead = true;
      return n;
    }).toList();
    await _save(updated);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // حذف إشعار
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> deleteNotification(String id) async {
    final updated = notificationsNotifier.value
        .where((n) => n.id != id)
        .toList();
    await _save(updated);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // حذف الكل
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> clearAll() async {
    await _save([]);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // حفظ داخلي + إشعار المستمعين
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static Future<void> _save(List<AppNotification> list) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_storageKey, AppNotification.encodeList(list));

    list.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.compareTo(a.createdAt));
    notificationsNotifier.value = List.from(list);
    unreadCountNotifier.value = list.where((n) => !n.isRead).length;
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // تهيئة المستمعين (foreground + openedApp)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  static void initializeListeners() {
    // إشعارات أثناء تشغيل التطبيق (foreground)
    FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen((RemoteMessage message) {
      addFromRemoteMessage(message);
    });

    // عند فتح التطبيق من إشعار (background → foreground)
    FirebaseMessaging.onMessageOpenedApp.listen((RemoteMessage message) {
      addFromRemoteMessage(message);
    });
  }
}

// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\core\services\storage_service.dart
// ==================================
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class StorageService {
  static const String _keyFirstTime = 'is_first_time';
  static const String _keyToken = 'auth_token';

  // حفظ أن المستخدم أتم شاشة الترحيب
  static Future<void> setFirstTimeCompleted() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(_keyFirstTime, false);
  }

  // التحقق هل هي المرة الأولى لفتح التطبيق
  static Future<bool> isFirstTime() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getBool(_keyFirstTime) ?? true;
  }

  // حفظ Token تسجيل الدخول
  static Future<void> saveToken(String token) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_keyToken, token);
  }

  // جلب Token
  static Future<String?> getToken() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getString(_keyToken);
  }

  // مسح التوكن (تسجيل الخروج)
  static Future<void> clear() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_keyToken);
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AppColors {
  static const Color primary = Color(0xFF14C8B0); // اللون الفيروزي الرئيسي
  static const Color primaryDark = Color(0xFF0EA28E);
  static const Color background = Color(0xFFF4F8F7); // خلفية فاتحة وناعمة
  static const Color cardBackground = Colors.white;
  static const Color textDark = Color(0xFF1E293B);
  static const Color textLight = Color(0xFF64748B);
  static const Color accentMint = Color(0xFFE6F8F5);
}

class AppTheme {
  static ThemeData get lightTheme {
    return ThemeData(
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      primaryColor: AppColors.primary,
      fontFamily: 'Cairo', // أو أي خط تفضله
      colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
        seedColor: AppColors.primary,
        primary: AppColors.primary,
        surface: AppColors.cardBackground,
      ),
      elevatedButtonTheme: ElevatedButtonThemeData(
        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
          elevation: 0,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(28),
          ),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\models\notification_model.dart
// ==================================
import 'dart:convert';

class AppNotification {
  final String id;
  final String title;
  final String body;
  final String? type;
  final int? orderId;
  final DateTime createdAt;
  bool isRead;
  final Map<String, dynamic>? data;

  AppNotification({
    required this.id,
    required this.title,
    required this.body,
    this.type,
    this.orderId,
    required this.createdAt,
    this.isRead = false,
    this.data,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'id': id,
    'title': title,
    'body': body,
    'type': type,
    'order_id': orderId,
    'created_at': createdAt.toIso8601String(),
    'is_read': isRead,
    'data': data,
  };

  factory AppNotification.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return AppNotification(
      id:
          json['id']?.toString() ??
          DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
      title: json['title']?.toString() ?? '',
      body: json['body']?.toString() ?? '',
      type: json['type']?.toString(),
      orderId: json['order_id'] is int
          ? json['order_id']
          : int.tryParse(json['order_id']?.toString() ?? ''),
      createdAt:
          DateTime.tryParse(json['created_at']?.toString() ?? '') ??
          DateTime.now(),
      isRead: json['is_read'] == true || json['is_read'] == 1,
      data: json['data'] is Map
          ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(json['data'])
          : null,
    );
  }

  factory AppNotification.fromRemoteMessage(Map<String, dynamic> message) {
    final data = message['data'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(message['data'])
        : <String, dynamic>{};

    final notification = message['notification'] is Map
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(message['notification'])
        : <String, dynamic>{};

    return AppNotification(
      id:
          message['messageId']?.toString() ??
          DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
      title: notification['title']?.toString() ?? '',
      body: notification['body']?.toString() ?? '',
      type: data['type']?.toString(),
      orderId: int.tryParse(data['order_id']?.toString() ?? ''),
      createdAt: DateTime.now(),
      isRead: false,
      data: data,
    );
  }

  static String encodeList(List<AppNotification> list) =>
      jsonEncode(list.map((e) => e.toJson()).toList());

  static List<AppNotification> decodeList(String raw) {
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
      if (decoded is List) {
        return decoded
            .map((e) => AppNotification.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e)))
            .toList();
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return [];
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:profil_Smile/core/localization/app_localizations.dart';

class OrderModel {
  final int id;
  final String patientName;
  final String status;
  final String? notes;
  final String deliveryDate;
  final String createdAt;
  final String doctorName;
  final String prostheticTypeName;
  final String clinicName;

  OrderModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.patientName,
    required this.status,
    this.notes,
    required this.deliveryDate,
    required this.createdAt,
    required this.doctorName,
    required this.prostheticTypeName,
    required this.clinicName,
  });

  factory OrderModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return OrderModel(
      id: json['id'] ?? 0,
      patientName: json['patient_name'] ?? 'بدون اسم',
      status: json['status'] ?? 'received',
      notes: json['notes'],
      deliveryDate: json['delivery_date'] ?? '',
      createdAt: json['created_at'] ?? '',
      doctorName: json['doctor']?['name'] ?? 'طبيب غير محدد',
      prostheticTypeName: json['prosthetic_type']?['name'] ?? 'تعويض غير محدد',
      clinicName: json['clinic']?['name'] ?? 'عيادة غير محددة',
    );
  }

  // نص حالة الطلب بالعربي
  String get statusArabicText {
    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'received':
        return 'تم الاستلام';
      case 'in_progress':
      case 'processing':
        return 'قيد التصنيع';
      case 'ready':
        return 'جاهز للتسليم';
      case 'delivered':
        return 'تم التسليم';
      default:
        return status;
    }
  }

  // لون حالة الطلب
  Color get statusColor {
    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'received':
        return Colors.blue;
      case 'in_progress':
      case 'processing':
        return Colors.orange;
      case 'ready':
        return Colors.teal;
      case 'delivered':
        return Colors.green;
      default:
        return Colors.grey;
    }
  }

  String getStatusTranslated(AppLocalizations loc) {
    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'received':
        return loc.translate('status_received') ?? 'تم الاستلام';
      case 'in_progress':
      case 'processing':
        return loc.translate('status_in_progress') ?? 'قيد التصنيع';
      case 'ready':
        return loc.translate('status_ready') ?? 'جاهز للتسليم';
      case 'delivered':
        return loc.translate('status_delivered') ?? 'تم التسليم';
      default:
        return status;
    }
  }
}

class UserModel {
  final int id;
  final String name;
  final String email;
  final String type;
  final int? clinicId;
  final String? clinicName;

  UserModel({
    required this.id,
    required this.name,
    required this.email,
    required this.type,
    this.clinicId,
    this.clinicName,
  });

  factory UserModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    // التعامل مع وجود المبدل user أو القراءة المباشرة
    final userData = json['user'] ?? json;

    return UserModel(
      id: userData['id'] ?? 0,
      name: userData['name'] ?? '',
      email: userData['email'] ?? '',
      type: userData['type'] ?? userData['user_type'] ?? 'clinic',
      clinicId: userData['clinic_id'],
      clinicName: userData['clinic']?['name'],
    );
  }
}

// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\providers\auth_provider.dart
// ==================================
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../core/services/api_service.dart';
import '../core/constants/api_constants.dart';

class AuthProvider with ChangeNotifier {
  bool _isLoading = false;
  String? _userType;
  String? _userName;

  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;
  String? get userType => _userType;
  String? get userName => _userName;

  Future<bool> login(String email, String password) async {
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final response = await ApiService.post(ApiConstants.login, {
        'email': email,
        'password': password,
      });

      final data = jsonDecode(response.body);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 && data['status'] == true) {
        // استخراج البيانات بناءً على الاستجابة الفعلية من السيرفر
        final responseData = data['data'];
        final token = responseData['token'];
        _userType = responseData['user_type'];
        _userName = responseData['user'] != null
            ? responseData['user']['name']
            : '';

        // حفظ البيانات محلياً
        final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
        await prefs.setString('auth_token', token);
        await prefs.setString('token', token);
        if (_userType != null) await prefs.setString('user_type', _userType!);
        if (_userName != null) await prefs.setString('user_name', _userName!);

        _isLoading = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return true;
      } else {
        _isLoading = false;
        notifyListeners();
        return false;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _isLoading = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return false;
    }
  }

  // الاستمرار في تسجيل الدخول تلقائياً
  Future<bool> checkAutoLogin() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final token = prefs.getString('auth_token') ?? prefs.getString('token');

    if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
      _userType = prefs.getString('user_type');
      _userName = prefs.getString('user_name');
      notifyListeners();
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  // تسجيل الخروج
  Future<void> logout() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.clear();
    _userType = null;
    _userName = null;
    notifyListeners();
  }
}



// ==================================
// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\providers\locale_provider.dart
// ==================================
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../core/services/api_service.dart';

class LocaleProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  Locale? _locale;

  // مفتاح حفظ اللغة في SharedPreferences
  static const String _languageKey = 'selected_language';

  // قائمة اللغات المدعومة
  static const List<Locale> supportedLocales = [
    Locale('ar'),
    Locale('en'),
    Locale('de'),
  ];

  Locale? get locale => _locale;

  LocaleProvider() {
    _loadSavedLocale();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSavedLocale() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final String? languageCode = prefs.getString(_languageKey);

    if (languageCode != null) {
      _locale = Locale(languageCode);
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  /// تعيين لغة جديدة وحفظها محلياً + إخبار السيرفر
  Future<void> setLocale(Locale locale) async {
    if (!supportedLocales.any((l) => l.languageCode == locale.languageCode)) {
      return;
    }

    // 1. تحديث الحالة محلياً
    _locale = locale;
    notifyListeners();

    // 2. حفظ محلياً في SharedPreferences
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setString(_languageKey, locale.languageCode);

    // 3. ✅ إرسال للسيرفر مع التحقق من الاستجابة
    await _syncLocaleWithServer(locale.languageCode);
  }

  /// ✅ دالة منفصلة لمزامنة اللغة مع السيرفر
  /// (يمكن استدعاؤها أيضاً عند بدء التطبيق للتأكد من التزامن)
  Future<void> _syncLocaleWithServer(String languageCode) async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final token = prefs.getString('auth_token');
    if (token == null || token.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      // ✅ غيّر من '/auth/locale' إلى '/locale'
      final response = await ApiService.post('/locale', {
        'locale': languageCode,
      });

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      } else {}
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  /// مزامنة يدوية (اختياري) - يمكن استدعاؤها عند تسجيل الدخول
  Future<void> syncCurrentLocale() async {
    if (_locale != null) {
      await _syncLocaleWithServer(_locale!.languageCode);
    }
  }

  /// العودة للغة الجهاز الافتراضية
  Future<void> clearLocale() async {
    _locale = null;
    notifyListeners();

    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_languageKey);
  }
}

// lib/providers/order_provider.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../models/order_model.dart';
import '../repositories/order_repository.dart';

class OrderProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  final OrderRepository _repository = OrderRepository();

  List<OrderModel> _orders = [];
  bool _isLoading = false;
  String _selectedClinicFilter = 'all';
  String _selectedStatusFilter = 'all';
  String _sortBy = 'date_asc';

  List<OrderModel> get orders => _orders;
  bool get isLoading => _isLoading;

  // الحصول على الطلبات المفلترة مباشرة دون إرهاق الـ UI
  List<OrderModel> get filteredOrders {
    List<OrderModel> list = List.from(_orders);

    if (_selectedStatusFilter != 'all') {
      list = list
          .where(
            (o) =>
                (o.status ?? '').toLowerCase() ==
                _selectedStatusFilter.toLowerCase(),
          )
          .toList();
    }

    list.sort((a, b) {
      if (a.deliveryDate == null) return 1;
      if (b.deliveryDate == null) return -1;
      return _sortBy == 'date_asc'
          ? a.deliveryDate!.compareTo(b.deliveryDate!)
          : b.deliveryDate!.compareTo(a.deliveryDate!);
    });

    return list;
  }

  // طلبات اليوم فقط
  // List<OrderModel> get todayOrders {
  //   final now = DateTime.now();
  //   return _orders.where((o) {
  //     if (o.deliveryDate == null) return false;
  //     return o.deliveryDate!.year == now.year &&
  //         o.deliveryDate!.month == now.month &&
  //         o.deliveryDate!.day == now.day;
  //   }).toList();
  // }

  Future<void> fetchOrders({required bool isAdmin}) async {
    _isLoading = true;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      _orders = await _repository.fetchOrders(isAdmin: isAdmin);
    } catch (e) {
    } finally {
      _isLoading = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void setFilterStatus(String status) {
    _selectedStatusFilter = status;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> loadOrders({required bool isAdmin}) async {
    // خطوة A: قراءة الكاش أولاً وعرضه فوراً للمستخدم بدون انتظار السيرفر
    _orders = await _repository.getLocalOrders();
    notifyListeners();

    // إذا لم يكن هناك كاش مخزن، نظهر مؤشر التحميل
    if (_orders.isEmpty) {
      _isLoading = true;
      notifyListeners();
    }

    // خطوة B: طلب البيانات الجديدة من الـ API في الخلفية
    try {
      final remoteOrders = await _repository.fetchRemoteOrders(
        isAdmin: isAdmin,
      );
      _orders = remoteOrders; // تحديث القائمة بالبيانات الجديدة
    } catch (e) {
    } finally {
      _isLoading = false;
      notifyListeners(); // إعادة رسم الشاشة بالبيانات الحديثة
    }
  }
}



// ==================================
// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\repositories\order_repository.dart
// ==================================
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../core/constants/api_constants.dart';
import '../core/services/api_service.dart';
import '../models/order_model.dart';
import 'dart:convert';

class OrderRepository {
  Future<List<OrderModel>> fetchOrders({required bool isAdmin}) async {
    final url = isAdmin ? ApiConstants.adminOrders : ApiConstants.clinicOrders;
    final response = await ApiService.get(url);

    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
      final List list = data['data'] ?? [];
      return list.map((json) => OrderModel.fromJson(json)).toList();
    } else {
      throw Exception('Failed to load orders');
    }
  }

  static const String _cacheKey = 'cached_orders_list';

  // 1. جلب البيانات المخزنة محلياً (Offline / Cache)
  Future<List<OrderModel>> getLocalOrders() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final jsonString = prefs.getString(_cacheKey);
    if (jsonString != null) {
      final List decoded = jsonDecode(jsonString);
      return decoded.map((e) => OrderModel.fromJson(e)).toList();
    }
    return [];
  }

  // 2. جلب البيانات من السيرفر وحفظها في الكاش
  Future<List<OrderModel>> fetchRemoteOrders({required bool isAdmin}) async {
    final url = isAdmin ? ApiConstants.adminOrders : ApiConstants.clinicOrders;
    final response = await ApiService.get(url);

    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
      final List list = data['data'] ?? [];

      // حفظ الاستجابة كـ String في SharedPreferences
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString(_cacheKey, jsonEncode(list));

      return list.map((json) => OrderModel.fromJson(json)).toList();
    } else {
      throw Exception('فشل في جلب البيانات من السيرفر');
    }
  }
}



// ==================================
// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\screens\ClinicProfileScreen.dart
// ==================================
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import 'package:profil_Smile/core/services/storage_service.dart';

import '../core/constants/api_constants.dart';
import '../core/localization/app_localizations.dart';
import '../core/services/api_service.dart';
import '../core/theme/app_theme.dart';

class ClinicTab extends StatefulWidget {
  const ClinicTab({super.key});

  @override
  State<ClinicTab> createState() => _ClinicTabState();
}

class _ClinicTabState extends State<ClinicTab> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final ImagePicker _picker = ImagePicker();

  // Controllers
  final TextEditingController _nameController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _phoneController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _addressController = TextEditingController();

  // State
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isSaving = false;
  bool _isEditing = false;

  // ✅ Images
  String? _logoPath;
  String? _coverPath;
  File? _selectedLogoFile;
  File? _selectedCoverFile;

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Translation Helpers
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  AppLocalizations? get _loc => AppLocalizations.of(context);
  String _t(String key) => _loc?.translate(key) ?? key;

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Image URLs
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  String? get _logoUrl {
    if (_selectedLogoFile != null) return null;
    if (_logoPath == null || _logoPath!.isEmpty) return null;
    if (_logoPath!.startsWith('http')) return _logoPath;

    final baseUrl = ApiConstants.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '');
    final cleanPath = _logoPath!.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^/+'), '');

    // ✅ إذا بدأ بـ storage، لا تكرره
    if (cleanPath.startsWith('storage/')) {
      return '$baseUrl/$cleanPath';
    }
    return '$baseUrl/storage/$cleanPath';
  }

  String? get _coverUrl {
    if (_selectedCoverFile != null) return null;
    if (_coverPath == null || _coverPath!.isEmpty) return null;
    if (_coverPath!.startsWith('http')) return _coverPath;

    final baseUrl = ApiConstants.baseUrl.replaceAll('/api', '');
    final cleanPath = _coverPath!.replaceAll(RegExp(r'^/+'), '');

    if (cleanPath.startsWith('storage/')) {
      return '$baseUrl/$cleanPath';
    }
    return '$baseUrl/storage/$cleanPath';
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Lifecycle
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _fetchClinicData();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _phoneController.dispose();
    _addressController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Fetch Clinic Data
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  Future<void> _fetchClinicData() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final response = await ApiService.get(ApiConstants.clinicProfile);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 || response.statusCode == 201) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
        final data = (decoded is Map && decoded.containsKey('data'))
            ? decoded['data']
            : decoded;

        // ✅ استخرج clinic (قد تكون داخل data.clinic أو data مباشرة)
        final clinicData = data['clinic'] ?? data;

        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _nameController.text =
                clinicData['name'] ?? clinicData['clinic_name'] ?? '';
            _phoneController.text =
                clinicData['phone'] ?? clinicData['mobile'] ?? '';
            _addressController.text = clinicData['address'] ?? '';

            // ✅ الصور
            _logoPath = clinicData['logo'];
            _coverPath = clinicData['cover'];

            _isLoading = false;
          });
        }
      } else {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Fetch error: $e');
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Pick Logo
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  Future<void> _pickLogo() async {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: Wrap(
          children: [
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(
                Icons.photo_library_rounded,
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
              title: Text(_t('gallery')),
              onTap: () async {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                final XFile? picked = await _picker.pickImage(
                  source: ImageSource.gallery,
                  imageQuality: 85,
                  maxWidth: 800,
                  maxHeight: 800,
                );
                if (picked != null) {
                  setState(() => _selectedLogoFile = File(picked.path));
                }
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(
                Icons.camera_alt_rounded,
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
              title: Text(_t('camera')),
              onTap: () async {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                final XFile? picked = await _picker.pickImage(
                  source: ImageSource.camera,
                  imageQuality: 85,
                  maxWidth: 800,
                  maxHeight: 800,
                );
                if (picked != null) {
                  setState(() => _selectedLogoFile = File(picked.path));
                }
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Pick Cover
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  Future<void> _pickCover() async {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) => SafeArea(
        child: Wrap(
          children: [
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(
                Icons.photo_library_rounded,
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
              title: Text(_t('gallery')),
              onTap: () async {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                final XFile? picked = await _picker.pickImage(
                  source: ImageSource.gallery,
                  imageQuality: 85,
                  maxWidth: 1600,
                  maxHeight: 900,
                );
                if (picked != null) {
                  setState(() => _selectedCoverFile = File(picked.path));
                }
              },
            ),
            ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(
                Icons.camera_alt_rounded,
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
              title: Text(_t('camera')),
              onTap: () async {
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                final XFile? picked = await _picker.pickImage(
                  source: ImageSource.camera,
                  imageQuality: 85,
                  maxWidth: 1600,
                  maxHeight: 900,
                );
                if (picked != null) {
                  setState(() => _selectedCoverFile = File(picked.path));
                }
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Update Clinic Profile (with images)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  Future<void> _updateClinicProfile() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    try {
      final url = ApiConstants.updateClinicProfile;

      var request = http.MultipartRequest('POST', Uri.parse(url));

      // ═══ Headers ═══
      final token = await StorageService.getToken();
      if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
        request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $token';
      }
      request.headers['Accept'] = 'application/json';

      // ═══ Fields ═══
      request.fields['name'] = _nameController.text.trim();
      request.fields['phone'] = _phoneController.text.trim();
      request.fields['address'] = _addressController.text.trim();

      // ⚠️ مهم: لا نستخدم _method=PUT لأن الـ Route يدعم POST مباشرة

      // ═══ رفع الشعار ═══
      if (_selectedLogoFile != null) {
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('logo', _selectedLogoFile!.path),
        );
      }

      // ═══ رفع الغلاف ═══
      if (_selectedCoverFile != null) {
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('cover', _selectedCoverFile!.path),
        );
      }

      // ═══ Send ═══
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      final response = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);

      debugPrint('📤 Update URL: $url');
      debugPrint('📤 Status: ${response.statusCode}');
      debugPrint('📤 Body: ${response.body}');

      // ═══ Success ═══
      if (response.statusCode == 200 || response.statusCode == 201) {
        final decoded = jsonDecode(response.body);
        final data = decoded['data'];
        final updatedClinic = data?['clinic'] ?? data;

        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            if (updatedClinic != null) {
              _nameController.text =
                  updatedClinic['name'] ?? _nameController.text;
              _phoneController.text =
                  updatedClinic['phone'] ?? _phoneController.text;
              _addressController.text =
                  updatedClinic['address'] ?? _addressController.text;

              // ✅ حدّث الصور
              _logoPath = updatedClinic['logo'];
              _coverPath = updatedClinic['cover'];

              _selectedLogoFile = null;
              _selectedCoverFile = null;

              // ✅ امسح كاش الصور
              imageCache.clear();
              imageCache.clearLiveImages();
            }
            _isSaving = false;
            _isEditing = false;
          });

          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(_t('clinic_updated_success')),
              backgroundColor: const Color(0xFF10B981),
              behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
            ),
          );
        }
      } else {
        // ═══ Error ═══
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() => _isSaving = false);
          String errorMsg = _t('save_failed');
          try {
            final err = jsonDecode(response.body);
            if (err['message'] != null) errorMsg = err['message'];
          } catch (_) {}
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(
              content: Text(errorMsg),
              backgroundColor: Colors.red,
              behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Update error: $e');
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSaving = false);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('${_t('connection_error')}: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
            behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // BUILD
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (_isLoading) {
      return const Center(
        child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppColors.primary),
      );
    }

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _fetchClinicData,
      color: AppColors.primary,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.0, vertical: 16.0),
        child: Form(
          key: _formKey,
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              // ═══ Header (Cover + Logo) ═══
              _buildHeaderCard(),

              const SizedBox(height: 24),

              // ═══ Title + Edit Button ═══
              Row(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      _t('clinic_management'),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 17,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: AppColors.textDark,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    onPressed: () => setState(() => _isEditing = !_isEditing),
                    icon: Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: _isEditing
                            ? Colors.red.withOpacity(0.1)
                            : AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.1),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                      ),
                      child: Icon(
                        _isEditing ? Icons.close_rounded : Icons.edit_rounded,
                        color: _isEditing ? Colors.red : AppColors.primary,
                        size: 18,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 12),

              // ═══ Input Fields ═══
              _buildInputField(
                label: _t('clinic_name'),
                controller: _nameController,
                icon: Icons.store_rounded,
                enabled: _isEditing,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildInputField(
                label: _t('phone_number'),
                controller: _phoneController,
                icon: Icons.phone_rounded,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
                enabled: _isEditing,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildInputField(
                label: _t('address'),
                controller: _addressController,
                icon: Icons.location_on_rounded,
                maxLines: 2,
                enabled: _isEditing,
              ),

              const SizedBox(height: 24),

              // ═══ Save Button ═══
              if (_isEditing)
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  height: 52,
                  child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
                      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      ),
                      elevation: 0,
                    ),
                    onPressed: _isSaving ? null : _updateClinicProfile,
                    icon: _isSaving
                        ? const SizedBox(
                            width: 20,
                            height: 20,
                            child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                              color: Colors.white,
                              strokeWidth: 2,
                            ),
                          )
                        : const Icon(Icons.save_outlined, color: Colors.white),
                    label: Text(
                      _isSaving ? _t('saving') : _t('save_changes'),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 15,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: Colors.white,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Header Card (Cover + Logo)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  Widget _buildHeaderCard() {
    return Column(
      children: [
        // ═══ Cover ═══
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: _isEditing ? _pickCover : null,
          child: Stack(
            children: [
              Container(
                height: 160,
                width: double.infinity,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: LinearGradient(
                    colors: [
                      AppColors.primary,
                      AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.85),
                    ],
                    begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                    end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                  ),
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  image: _selectedCoverFile != null || _coverUrl != null
                      ? DecorationImage(
                          image: _selectedCoverFile != null
                              ? FileImage(_selectedCoverFile!)
                              : NetworkImage(_coverUrl!) as ImageProvider,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          onError: (_, __) {},
                        )
                      : null,
                ),
                child: (_selectedCoverFile == null && _coverUrl == null)
                    ? Center(
                        child: Column(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            Icon(
                              Icons.image_outlined,
                              size: 40,
                              color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.5),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 8),
                            Text(
                              _isEditing
                                  ? _t('tap_to_pick_cover')
                                  : _t('no_cover'),
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white.withOpacity(0.7),
                                fontSize: 13,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      )
                    : null,
              ),
              // ✅ Overlay عند التعديل
              if (_isEditing)
                Positioned(
                  top: 12,
                  right: 12,
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 10,
                      vertical: 6,
                    ),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.black54,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                    ),
                    child: Row(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      children: [
                        const Icon(
                          Icons.edit_rounded,
                          color: Colors.white,
                          size: 14,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        Text(
                          _t('change_cover'),
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.white,
                            fontSize: 11,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 16),

        // ═══ Logo (Circular) ═══
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: _isEditing ? _pickLogo : null,
          child: Stack(
            children: [
              Container(
                width: 100,
                height: 100,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  border: Border.all(color: AppColors.primary, width: 4),
                  boxShadow: [
                    BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.15),
                      blurRadius: 12,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                    ),
                  ],
                  image: _selectedLogoFile != null || _logoUrl != null
                      ? DecorationImage(
                          image: _selectedLogoFile != null
                              ? FileImage(_selectedLogoFile!)
                              : NetworkImage(_logoUrl!) as ImageProvider,
                          fit: BoxFit.cover,
                          onError: (_, __) {},

                      : null,
                ),
                child: (_selectedLogoFile == null && _logoUrl == null)
                    ? const Icon(
                        Icons.local_hospital_rounded,
                        size: 45,
                        color: AppColors.primary,
                      )
                    : null,
              ),
              // ✅ أيقونة الكاميرا عند التعديل
              if (_isEditing)
                Positioned(
                  bottom: 0,
                  right: 0,
                  child: Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: AppColors.primary,
                      shape: BoxShape.circle,
                      border: Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 2),
                    ),
                    child: const Icon(
                      Icons.camera_alt_rounded,
                      color: Colors.white,
                      size: 14,
                    ),

          _nameController.text.isNotEmpty
              ? _nameController.text

            fontSize: 20,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,

          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 8),

          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.1),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          ),
          child: Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              const Icon(
                Icons.verified_rounded,
                size: 14,
                color: AppColors.primary,
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 4),
              Text(
                _t('active_account'),
                style: const TextStyle(
                  color: AppColors.primary,
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                ),
              ),

          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  // Input Field
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
  Widget _buildInputField({
    required String label,
    required TextEditingController controller,
    required IconData icon,
    bool enabled = false,
    int maxLines = 1,
    TextInputType keyboardType = TextInputType.text,
  }) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: enabled ? Colors.white : const Color(0xFFF8FAFC),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
        border: Border.all(
          color: enabled ? AppColors.primary : const Color(0xFFE2E8F0),
          width: enabled ? 1.5 : 1,
        ),
      ),
      child: TextFormField(
        controller: controller,
        enabled: enabled,
        maxLines: maxLines,
        keyboardType: keyboardType,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontSize: 14,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: enabled ? AppColors.textDark : const Color(0xFF64748B),
        ),
        validator: (value) {
          if (enabled && (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty)) {
            return _t('required_field');
          }
          return null;
        },
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          labelText: label,
          labelStyle: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: enabled ? AppColors.primary : const Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          ),
          prefixIcon: Icon(
            icon,
            color: enabled ? AppColors.primary : const Color(0xFF94A3B8),
            size: 20,
          ),
          border: InputBorder.none,
          contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
            horizontal: 14,
            vertical: 12,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}



// ==================================
// File: D:\Lab\lab_smile\lib\screens\create_order_screen.dart
