import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';
import '../core/constants/api_constants.dart';
import '../core/localization/app_localizations.dart';
import '../core/services/api_service.dart';
import '../core/theme/app_theme.dart';

class CreateOrderScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreateOrderScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CreateOrderScreen> createState() => _CreateOrderScreenState();
}

class _CreateOrderScreenState extends State<CreateOrderScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

  final TextEditingController _patientController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _patientNumberController =
      TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _xmlNumberController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _orderDateController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _deliveryDateController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _sessionTimeController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _shadeController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _additionalNotesController =
      TextEditingController();

  dynamic _selectedDoctorId;
  dynamic _selectedProstheticTypeId;
  dynamic _selectedStartStageId;

  List<dynamic> _doctorsList = [];
  List<dynamic> _prostheticTypesList = [];
  List<dynamic> _stagesList = [];
  bool _isLoadingData = true;

  File? _selectedImage;
  String? _uploadedImagePath;
  bool _isUploadingImage = false;
  final ImagePicker _picker = ImagePicker();

  bool _isSubmitting = false;

  AppLocalizations? get _loc => AppLocalizations.of(context);
  String _t(String key) => _loc?.translate(key) ?? key;
  String _tArgs(String key, Map<String, String> args) =>
      _loc?.translateWithArgs(key, args) ?? key;
  bool get _isRTL => Localizations.localeOf(context).languageCode == 'ar';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _orderDateController.text = DateTime.now().toString().split(' ')[0];
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _fetchInitialData();
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _patientController.dispose();
    _patientNumberController.dispose();
    _xmlNumberController.dispose();
    _orderDateController.dispose();
    _deliveryDateController.dispose();
    _sessionTimeController.dispose();
    _shadeController.dispose();
    _additionalNotesController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _fetchInitialData() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _isLoadingData = true);

    try {
      final doctorsRes = await ApiService.get(ApiConstants.clinicDoctors);
      final prostheticRes = await ApiService.get(ApiConstants.prostheticTypes);

      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          if (doctorsRes.statusCode == 200 || doctorsRes.statusCode == 201) {
            final docData = jsonDecode(doctorsRes.body);
            _doctorsList = docData is List ? docData : (docData['data'] ?? []);
          }

          if (prostheticRes.statusCode == 200 ||
              prostheticRes.statusCode == 201) {
            final prosthData = jsonDecode(prostheticRes.body);
            _prostheticTypesList = prosthData is List
                ? prosthData
                : (prosthData['data'] ?? []);
          }

          _isLoadingData = false;
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isLoadingData = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _showImagePickerModal() async {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      shape: const RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(20)),
      ),
      builder: (ctx) {
        return SafeArea(
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16.0),
            child: Wrap(
              children: [
                ListTile(
                  leading: const Icon(
                    Icons.photo_library_outlined,
                    color: AppColors.primary,
                  ),
                  title: Text(
                    _t('gallery'),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                  ),
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _pickAndUploadImage(ImageSource.gallery);
                  },
                ),
                ListTile(
                  leading: const Icon(
                    Icons.camera_alt_outlined,
                    color: AppColors.primary,
                  ),
                  title: Text(
                    _t('camera'),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
                  ),
                  onTap: () {
                    Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _pickAndUploadImage(ImageSource.camera);
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> _pickAndUploadImage(ImageSource source) async {
    final XFile? pickedFile = await _picker.pickImage(
      source: source,
      imageQuality: 80,
    );
    if (pickedFile == null) return;

    setState(() {
      _selectedImage = File(pickedFile.path);
      _isUploadingImage = true;
      _uploadedImagePath = null;
    });

    try {
      var request = http.MultipartRequest(
        'POST',
        Uri.parse('https://magichandsapp.com/lab/upload.php'),
      );

      request.files.add(
        await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('file', pickedFile.path),
      );

      var streamedResponse = await request.send();
      var response = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        var data = jsonDecode(response.body);
        if (data['success'] == true) {
          setState(() {
            _uploadedImagePath = data['file_path'];
          });
        } else {
          _showSnackBar(
            data['message'] ?? _t('file_upload_failed'),
            Colors.red,
          );
          setState(() => _selectedImage = null);
        }
      } else {
        _showSnackBar(_t('image_upload_server_error'), Colors.red);
        setState(() => _selectedImage = null);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      _showSnackBar('${_t("image_upload_connection_error")}: $e', Colors.red);
      setState(() => _selectedImage = null);
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isUploadingImage = false);
      }
    }
  }

  void _calculateExpectedDeliveryDate() {
    int daysToAdd = 0;

    if (_selectedStartStageId != null && _stagesList.isNotEmpty) {
      final selectedStage = _stagesList.firstWhere(
        (e) => e['id'] == _selectedStartStageId,
        orElse: () => null,
      );
      if (selectedStage != null) {
        daysToAdd =
            selectedStage['expected_days'] ?? selectedStage['days'] ?? 0;
      }
    }

    if (daysToAdd == 0 && _selectedProstheticTypeId != null) {
      final selectedType = _prostheticTypesList.firstWhere(
        (e) => e['id'] == _selectedProstheticTypeId,
        orElse: () => null,
      );
      if (selectedType != null) {
        daysToAdd = selectedType['expected_days'] ?? selectedType['days'] ?? 3;
      }
    }

    if (daysToAdd > 0) {
      final expectedDate = DateTime.now().add(Duration(days: daysToAdd));
      _deliveryDateController.text = expectedDate.toString().split(' ')[0];
    }
  }

  Future<void> _selectDeliveryDate(BuildContext context) async {
    final DateTime now = DateTime.now();
    final DateTime initial = _deliveryDateController.text.isNotEmpty
        ? DateTime.tryParse(_deliveryDateController.text) ?? now
        : now;

    final DateTime? pickedDate = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: initial.isBefore(now) ? now : initial,
      firstDate: now,
      lastDate: DateTime(2030),
      builder: (ctx, child) {
        return Theme(
          data: Theme.of(ctx).copyWith(
            colorScheme: const ColorScheme.light(
              primary: AppColors.primary,
              onPrimary: Colors.white,
              surface: Colors.white,
              onSurface: AppColors.textDark,
            ),
            dialogTheme: DialogThemeData(
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          child: Directionality(
            textDirection: _isRTL ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr,
            child: child!,
          ),
        );
      },
    );

    if (pickedDate != null) {
      setState(() {
        _deliveryDateController.text = pickedDate.toString().split(' ')[0];
      });
    }
  }

  void _selectSessionTime(BuildContext context) {
    TimeOfDay initialTime = TimeOfDay.now();
    if (_sessionTimeController.text.isNotEmpty) {
      final parts = _sessionTimeController.text.split(':');
      if (parts.length == 2) {
        initialTime = TimeOfDay(
          hour: int.tryParse(parts[0]) ?? initialTime.hour,
          minute: int.tryParse(parts[1]) ?? initialTime.minute,
        );
      }
    }

    TimeOfDay tempTime = initialTime;

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return Directionality(
          textDirection: _isRTL ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr,
          child: Container(
            height: 300,
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
            ),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 16,
                    vertical: 12,
                  ),
                  child: Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                        child: Text(
                          _t('cancel'),
                          style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                        ),
                      ),
                      Text(
                        _t('session_time_picker'),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: AppColors.textDark,
                        ),
                      ),
                      TextButton(
                        onPressed: () {
                          final String hour = tempTime.hour.toString().padLeft(
                            2,
                            '0',
                          );
                          final String minute = tempTime.minute
                              .toString()
                              .padLeft(2, '0');
                          setState(() {
                            _sessionTimeController.text = '$hour:$minute';
                          });
                          Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        },
                        child: Text(
                          _t('confirm'),
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: AppColors.primary,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const Divider(height: 1),
                Expanded(
                  child: CupertinoTimerPicker(
                    mode: CupertinoTimerPickerMode.hms,
                    initialTimerDuration: Duration(
                      hours: initialTime.hour,
                      minutes: initialTime.minute,
                    ),
                    onTimerDurationChanged: (Duration newDuration) {
                      tempTime = TimeOfDay(
                        hour: newDuration.inHours % 24,
                        minute: newDuration.inMinutes % 60,
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _showSelectionBottomSheet({
    required String title,
    required List<dynamic> items,
    required dynamic selectedValue,
    required String Function(dynamic) itemLabel,
    required Function(dynamic) onSelect,
  }) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) {
        return Directionality(
          textDirection: _isRTL ? TextDirection.rtl : TextDirection.ltr,
          child: Container(
            constraints: BoxConstraints(
              maxHeight: MediaQuery.of(ctx).size.height * 0.6,
            ),
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.white,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(top: Radius.circular(24)),
            ),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16, horizontal: 16),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Center(
                  child: Container(
                    width: 40,
                    height: 4,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.grey.shade300,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                Text(
                  title,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 16,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: AppColors.textDark,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                Divider(color: Colors.grey.shade200, height: 1),
                Flexible(
                  child: ListView.builder(
                    shrinkWrap: true,
                    itemCount: items.length,
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final item = items[index];
                      final isSelected = item['id'] == selectedValue;
                      return ListTile(
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                        ),
                        tileColor: isSelected
                            ? AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.08)
                            : Colors.transparent,
                        title: Text(
                          itemLabel(item),
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: isSelected
                                ? FontWeight.bold
                                : FontWeight.normal,
                            color: isSelected
                                ? AppColors.primary
                                : AppColors.textDark,
                          ),
                        ),
                        trailing: isSelected
                            ? const Icon(
                                Icons.check_circle,
                                color: AppColors.primary,
                              )
                            : null,
                        onTap: () {
                          onSelect(item['id']);
                          Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        },
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  void _onProstheticTypeChanged(dynamic typeId) {
    setState(() {
      _selectedProstheticTypeId = typeId;
      _selectedStartStageId = null;
      _stagesList = [];

      final selectedObj = _prostheticTypesList.firstWhere(
        (element) => element['id'] == typeId,
        orElse: () => null,
      );

      if (selectedObj != null && selectedObj['stages'] != null) {
        _stagesList = selectedObj['stages'] as List<dynamic>;
      }

      _calculateExpectedDeliveryDate();
    });
  }

  Future<bool> _confirmEmptyField(String fieldName) async {
    return await showDialog<bool>(
          context: context,
          builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            ),
            title: Text(
              _t('reminder'),
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            content: Text(_tArgs('confirm_empty_field', {'field': fieldName})),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                child: Text(_t('edit_field')),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
                  shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  ),
                ),
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
                child: Text(
                  _t('continue_btn'),
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ) ??
        false;
  }

  void _showSnackBar(String text, Color bg) {
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(text),
        backgroundColor: bg,
        behavior: SnackBarBehavior.floating,
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10)),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _submitOrder() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    final rawPatientName = _patientController.text.trim();
    final rawPatientNumber = _patientNumberController.text.trim();

    if (rawPatientName.isEmpty && rawPatientNumber.isEmpty) {
      _showSnackBar(_t('enter_patient_name_or_number'), Colors.orange);
      return;
    }

    final String finalPatientName = rawPatientName.isNotEmpty
        ? rawPatientName
        : _tArgs('patient_number_prefix', {'number': rawPatientNumber});

    if (_selectedDoctorId == null || _selectedProstheticTypeId == null) {
      _showSnackBar(_t('select_doctor_and_prosthetic'), Colors.orange);
      return;
    }

    if (_shadeController.text.trim().isEmpty) {
      bool confirmShade = await _confirmEmptyField(_t('shade_field'));
      if (!confirmShade) return;
    }

    if (_uploadedImagePath == null && _selectedImage == null) {
      bool confirmImage = await _confirmEmptyField(_t('prosthetic_image'));
      if (!confirmImage) return;
    }

    if (_isUploadingImage) {
      _showSnackBar(_t('wait_for_image_upload'), Colors.orange);
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isSubmitting = true);

    try {
      final body = {
        'doctor_id': _selectedDoctorId,
        'prosthetic_type_id': _selectedProstheticTypeId,
        'start_stage_id': _selectedStartStageId,
        'patient_name': finalPatientName,
        'patient_number': rawPatientNumber,
        'xml_number': _xmlNumberController.text.trim(),
        'shade': _shadeController.text.trim(),
        'delivery_date': _deliveryDateController.text,
        'session_time': _sessionTimeController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
            ? _sessionTimeController.text.trim()
            : null,
        'image_path': _uploadedImagePath,
        'notes': _additionalNotesController.text.trim(),
        'status': 'received',
      };

      final response = await ApiService.post(ApiConstants.clinicOrders, body);

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (response.statusCode == 200 || response.statusCode == 201) {
        _showSnackBar(_t('order_added_success'), Colors.green);
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
      } else {
        _showSnackBar(
          '${_t("add_failed")} (${response.statusCode}): ${response.body}',
          Colors.red,
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        _showSnackBar('${_t("connection_error")}: $e', Colors.red);
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSubmitting = false);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(
          _t('create_order_title'),
          style: const TextStyle(
            color: AppColors.textDark,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            fontSize: 18,
          ),
        ),
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        elevation: 0,
        centerTitle: true,
        iconTheme: const IconThemeData(color: AppColors.textDark),
      ),
      body: _isLoadingData
          ? const Center(
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppColors.primary),
            )
          : SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 16.0,
                vertical: 12.0,
              ),
              child: Form(
                key: _formKey,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    _buildSectionCard(
                      title: _t('basic_info'),
                      icon: Icons.person_outline,
                      children: [
                        _buildLabel('${_t("doctor")} *'),
                        _buildCustomSelectTile(
                          hint: _t('select_doctor'),
                          value: _selectedDoctorId != null
                              ? _doctorsList.firstWhere(
                                  (d) => d['id'] == _selectedDoctorId,
                                  orElse: () => {},
                                )['name']
                              : null,
                          onTap: () {
                            _showSelectionBottomSheet(
                              title: _t('select_doctor'),
                              items: _doctorsList,
                              selectedValue: _selectedDoctorId,
                              itemLabel: (doc) => doc['name'] ?? '',
                              onSelect: (val) {
                                setState(() => _selectedDoctorId = val);
                              },
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        Row(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Expanded(
                              flex: 2,
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  _buildLabel(_t('patient_name')),
                                  _buildTextField(
                                    _patientController,
                                    _t('enter_patient_name'),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
                            Expanded(
                              flex: 1,
                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                children: [
                                  _buildLabel(_t('patient_number')),
                                  _buildTextField(
                                    _patientNumberController,
                                    '1234',
                                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        _buildLabel(_t('xml_number')),
                        _buildTextField(
                          _xmlNumberController,
                          _t('enter_xml_number'),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        _buildLabel('${_t("prosthetic_type")} *'),
                        _buildCustomSelectTile(
                          hint: _t('select_prosthetic_type'),
                          value: _selectedProstheticTypeId != null
                              ? _prostheticTypesList.firstWhere(
                                  (p) => p['id'] == _selectedProstheticTypeId,
                                  orElse: () => {},
                                )['name']
                              : null,
                          onTap: () {
                            _showSelectionBottomSheet(
                              title: _t('select_prosthetic_type'),
                              items: _prostheticTypesList,
                              selectedValue: _selectedProstheticTypeId,
                              itemLabel: (type) =>
                                  type['name']?.toString() ?? '',
                              onSelect: (val) {
                                _onProstheticTypeChanged(val);
                              },
                            );
                          },
                        ),
                        if (_stagesList.isNotEmpty) ...[
                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          _buildLabel(_t('start_stage')),
                          _buildCustomSelectTile(
                            hint: _t('select_start_stage'),
                            value: _selectedStartStageId != null
                                ? _stagesList.firstWhere(
                                    (s) => s['id'] == _selectedStartStageId,
                                    orElse: () => {},
                                  )['name']
                                : null,
                            onTap: () {
                              _showSelectionBottomSheet(
                                title: _t('select_start_stage'),
                                items: _stagesList,
                                selectedValue: _selectedStartStageId,
                                itemLabel: (stage) =>
                                    stage['name']?.toString() ?? '',
                                onSelect: (val) {
                                  setState(() {
                                    _selectedStartStageId = val;
                                    _calculateExpectedDeliveryDate();
                                  });
                                },
                              );
                            },
                          ),
                        ],
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    _buildSectionCard(
                      title: _t('dates_times'),
                      icon: Icons.calendar_today_outlined,
                      children: [
                        _buildDateTimeCard(
                          title: _t('order_date'),
                          value: _orderDateController.text,
                          icon: Icons.calendar_today,
                          color: Colors.blue,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        _buildDateTimeCard(
                          title: _t('delivery_date'),
                          value: _deliveryDateController.text.isNotEmpty
                              ? _deliveryDateController.text
                              : _t('select_date'),
                          icon: Icons.event_available,
                          color: Colors.green,
                          onTap: () => _selectDeliveryDate(context),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(height: 10),
                        _buildDateTimeCard(
                          title: _t('session_time'),
                          value: _sessionTimeController.text.isNotEmpty
                              ? _sessionTimeController.text
                              : _t('select_session_time_hint'),
                          icon: Icons.access_time_filled,
                          color: Colors.orange,
                          onTap: () => _selectSessionTime(context),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    _buildSectionCard(
                      title: _t('prosthetic_details_image'),
                      icon: Icons.palette_outlined,
                      children: [
                        _buildLabel(_t('shade')),
                        _buildTextField(_shadeController, _t('shade_example')),
                        const SizedBox(height: 12),
                        _buildLabel(_t('prosthetic_image')),
                        _buildImageUploader(),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    _buildSectionCard(
                      title: _t('additional_notes'),
                      icon: Icons.note_alt_outlined,
                      children: [
                        _buildTextField(
                          _additionalNotesController,
                          _t('type_notes_hint'),
                          maxLines: 3,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 24),
                    SizedBox(
                      width: double.infinity,
                      height: 52,
                      child: ElevatedButton(
                        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                          backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
                          elevation: 2,
                          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          ),
                        ),
                        onPressed: _isSubmitting ? null : _submitOrder,
                        child: _isSubmitting
                            ? const SizedBox(
                                width: 24,
                                height: 24,
                                child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                  strokeWidth: 2.5,
                                ),
                              )
                            : Text(
                                _t('save_and_add_order'),
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 16,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                ),
                              ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCustomSelectTile({
    required String hint,
    required String? value,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
      child: Container(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFFF9FAFB),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE5E7EB)),
        ),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                value ?? hint,
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13,
                  color: value != null ? AppColors.textDark : Colors.grey,
                  fontWeight: value != null
                      ? FontWeight.w500
                      : FontWeight.normal,
                ),
                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              ),
            ),
            const Icon(
              Icons.keyboard_arrow_down_rounded,
              color: AppColors.primary,
              size: 22,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDateTimeCard({
    required String title,
    required String value,
    required IconData icon,
    required Color color,
    VoidCallback? onTap,
  }) {
    final placeholderKeywords = [
      _t('select_date'),
      _t('select_session_time_hint'),
      'اختر',
      'حدد',
    ];

    final isPlaceholder = placeholderKeywords.any((k) => value.contains(k));

    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: color.withOpacity(0.05),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: color.withOpacity(0.2)),
      ),
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: onTap,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 10),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: color.withOpacity(0.15),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 20),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 10),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        title,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: Colors.grey.shade700,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        value,
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: onTap != null && isPlaceholder
                              ? Colors.grey.shade600
                              : AppColors.textDark,
                        ),
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                if (onTap != null)
                  Icon(
                    Icons.chevron_right,
                    size: 18,
                    color: color.withOpacity(0.7),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildImageUploader() {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: _isUploadingImage ? null : _showImagePickerModal,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Container(
        height: 130,
        width: double.infinity,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: const Color(0xFFF9FAFB),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(color: const Color(0xFFE5E7EB)),
        ),
        child: _isUploadingImage
            ? Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  const CircularProgressIndicator(
                    color: AppColors.primary,
                    strokeWidth: 2,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 10),
                  Text(
                    _t('uploading_image'),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: AppColors.primary,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              )
            : _selectedImage != null
            ? Stack(
                children: [
                  ClipRRect(
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    child: Image.file(
                      _selectedImage!,
                      width: double.infinity,
                      height: double.infinity,
                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Positioned(
                    top: 6,
                    left: 6,
                    child: CircleAvatar(
                      backgroundColor: Colors.black54,
                      radius: 16,
                      child: IconButton(
                        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                        icon: const Icon(
                          Icons.close,
                          size: 16,
                          color: Colors.white,
                        ),
                        onPressed: () {
                          setState(() {
                            _selectedImage = null;
                            _uploadedImagePath = null;
                          });
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (_uploadedImagePath != null)
                    Positioned(
                      bottom: 0,
                      left: 0,
                      right: 0,
                      child: Container(
                        color: Colors.black87,
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 8,
                          vertical: 4,
                        ),
                        child: Row(
                          children: [
                            const Icon(
                              Icons.check_circle,
                              color: Colors.greenAccent,
                              size: 14,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 4),
                            Expanded(
                              child: Text(
                                '${_t("uploaded_label")}: $_uploadedImagePath',
                                style: const TextStyle(
                                  color: Colors.white,
                                  fontSize: 10,
                                ),
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              )
            : Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                children: [
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.add_a_photo_outlined,
                    color: AppColors.primary,
                    size: 32,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  Text(
                    _t('image_upload_hint'),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
      ),
    );
  }

  InputDecoration _buildInputDecoration({String? hint, Widget? suffixIcon}) {
    return InputDecoration(
      hintText: hint,
      hintStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Colors.grey),
      suffixIcon: suffixIcon,
      filled: true,
      fillColor: const Color(0xFFF9FAFB),
      contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 14, vertical: 12),
      border: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE5E7EB)),
      ),
      enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: Color(0xFFE5E7EB)),
      ),
      focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
        borderSide: const BorderSide(color: AppColors.primary, width: 1.5),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSectionCard({
    required String title,
    required IconData icon,
    required List<Widget> children,
  }) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.02),
            blurRadius: 8,
            offset: const Offset(0, 2),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Row(
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 20, color: AppColors.primary),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  title,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 15,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: AppColors.textDark,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          const Divider(height: 16, thickness: 0.5),
          ...children,
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLabel(String text) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 6.0),
      child: Text(
        text,
        style: const TextStyle(
          fontSize: 12,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          color: AppColors.textDark,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTextField(
    TextEditingController controller,
    String hint, {
    int maxLines = 1,
    TextInputType keyboardType = TextInputType.text,
    String? Function(String?)? validator,
  }) {
    return TextFormField(
      controller: controller,
      maxLines: maxLines,
      keyboardType: keyboardType,
      validator: validator,
      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: AppColors.textDark),
      decoration: _buildInputDecoration(hint: hint),
    );
  }
}

import '../core/constants/api_constants.dart';
import '../core/localization/app_localizations.dart';
import '../core/services/api_service.dart';
import '../core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import '../providers/locale_provider.dart';
import 'ClinicProfileScreen.dart';
import 'Statistics_screen.dart';
import 'orders_list_screen.dart';
import 'create_order_screen.dart';
import 'order_details_screen.dart';

class HomeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<HomeScreen> createState() => _HomeScreenState();
}

class _HomeScreenState extends State<HomeScreen> {
  int _currentIndex = 0;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final loc = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    String tr(String key) => loc?.translate(key) ?? key;

    final List<Widget> pages = [
      _HomeTab(onNavigateToOrders: () => setState(() => _currentIndex = 1)),
      const OrdersListScreen(),
      const ClinicTab(),
      const StatisticsTab(),
    ];

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      body: SafeArea(
        child: IndexedStack(index: _currentIndex, children: pages),
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: BottomNavigationBar(
        currentIndex: _currentIndex,
        onTap: (index) => setState(() => _currentIndex = index),
        type: BottomNavigationBarType.fixed,
        selectedItemColor: AppColors.primary,
        unselectedItemColor: AppColors.textLight,
        showUnselectedLabels: true,
        items: [
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.home_rounded),
            label: tr('nav_home'),
          ),
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.assignment_outlined),
            label: tr('nav_orders'),
          ),
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.local_hospital_outlined),
            label: tr('nav_clinic'),
          ),
          BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.bar_chart_rounded),
            label: tr('nav_statistics'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _HomeTab extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback onNavigateToOrders;
  const _HomeTab({required this.onNavigateToOrders});

  @override
  State<_HomeTab> createState() => _HomeTabState();
}

class _HomeTabState extends State<_HomeTab> {
  bool _isLoading = true;
  List<dynamic> _orders = [];

  AppLocalizations? get _loc => AppLocalizations.of(context);
  String _t(String key) => _loc?.translate(key) ?? key;
  String _tArgs(String key, Map<String, String> args) =>
      _loc?.translateWithArgs(key, args) ?? key;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      _fetchOrders();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _fetchOrders() async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final response = await ApiService.get(ApiConstants.clinicOrders);

      if (response.statusCode == 200 || response.statusCode == 201) {
        final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            if (data is List) {
              _orders = data;
            } else if (data is Map && data.containsKey('data')) {
              _orders = data['data'] ?? [];
            } else {
              _orders = [];
            }

            _orders.sort((a, b) {
              final dateAStr = a['delivery_date']?.toString();
              final dateBStr = b['delivery_date']?.toString();

              if (dateAStr == null || dateAStr.isEmpty) return 1;
              if (dateBStr == null || dateBStr.isEmpty) return -1;

              final dateA = DateTime.tryParse(dateAStr);
              final dateB = DateTime.tryParse(dateBStr);

              if (dateA == null) return 1;
              if (dateB == null) return -1;

              return dateA.compareTo(dateB);
            });

            _isLoading = false;
          });
        }
      } else {
        if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _showLanguageDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (BuildContext dialogContext) {
        final currentLocale = context.read<LocaleProvider>().locale;

        return AlertDialog(
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          ),
          title: Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.language, color: AppColors.primary),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  _t('select_language'),
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 15),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              _buildLangTile(
                dialogContext,
                currentLocale,
                'ar',
                '🇸🇾',
                'العربية',
              ),
              const Divider(),
              _buildLangTile(
                dialogContext,
                currentLocale,
                'en',
                '🇬🇧',
                'English',
              ),
              const Divider(),
              _buildLangTile(
                dialogContext,
                currentLocale,
                'de',
                '🇩🇪',
                'Deutsch',
              ),
            ],
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLangTile(
    BuildContext dialogContext,
    Locale? currentLocale,
    String code,
    String flag,
    String label,
  ) {
    final isSelected = currentLocale?.languageCode == code;
    return ListTile(
      leading: Text(flag, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22)),
      title: Text(
        label,
        style: TextStyle(
          fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
          color: isSelected ? AppColors.primary : null,
        ),
      ),
      trailing: isSelected
          ? const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: AppColors.primary)
          : null,
      onTap: () {
        context.read<LocaleProvider>().setLocale(Locale(code));
        Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
      },
    );
  }

  Color _getStatusColor(String? rawStatus) {
    if (rawStatus == null) return const Color(0xFF64748B);

    switch (rawStatus.toLowerCase().trim()) {
      case 'received':
      case 'pending':
        return const Color(0xFFF59E0B);
      case 'in_progress':
        return const Color(0xFF3B82F6);
      case 'approved':
      case 'completed':
      case 'delivered':
        return const Color(0xFF10B981);
      case 'cancelled':
        return const Color(0xFFEF4444);
      case 'needs_redo':
        return const Color(0xFF8B5CF6);
      default:
        return const Color(0xFF64748B);
    }
  }

  IconData _getStatusIcon(String? rawStatus) {
    if (rawStatus == null) return Icons.info_outline;

    switch (rawStatus.toLowerCase().trim()) {
      case 'received':
        return Icons.inbox_rounded;
      case 'pending':
        return Icons.hourglass_empty_rounded;
      case 'in_progress':
        return Icons.autorenew_rounded;
      case 'approved':
        return Icons.check_circle_outline_rounded;
      case 'completed':
        return Icons.task_alt_rounded;
      case 'delivered':
        return Icons.local_shipping_rounded;
      case 'cancelled':
        return Icons.cancel_outlined;
      case 'needs_redo':
        return Icons.replay_rounded;
      default:
        return Icons.info_outline;
    }
  }

  String _getStatusTranslation(String? rawStatus) {
    if (rawStatus == null || rawStatus.isEmpty) return '';
    final key = 'status_${rawStatus.toLowerCase().trim()}';
    final translated = _loc?.translate(key);
    return (translated != null && translated != key) ? translated : rawStatus;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _fetchOrders,
      color: AppColors.primary,
      child: SingleChildScrollView(
        physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 20.0, vertical: 12.0),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // الهيدر العلوي
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    // زر اللغة
                    Container(
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.white,
                        shape: BoxShape.circle,
                        boxShadow: [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.05),
                            blurRadius: 10,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                      child: IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(
                          Icons.language_rounded,
                          color: AppColors.primary,
                        ),
                        onPressed: () => _showLanguageDialog(context),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),

                    // ✅ زر الإشعارات مع Badge تفاعلي
                    ValueListenableBuilder<int>(
                      valueListenable: NotificationService.unreadCountNotifier,
                      builder: (context, unreadCount, _) {
                        return Stack(
                          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                          children: [
                            Container(
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                shape: BoxShape.circle,
                                boxShadow: [
                                  BoxShadow(
                                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.05),
                                    blurRadius: 10,
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                              child: IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(
                                  Icons.notifications_none_rounded,
                                ),
                                onPressed: () {
                                  Navigator.push(
                                    context,
                                    MaterialPageRoute(
                                      builder: (_) =>
                                          const NotificationsScreen(),
                                    ),
                                  );
                                },
                              ),
                            ),
                            if (unreadCount > 0)
                              Positioned(
                                right: 4,
                                top: 4,
                                child: Container(
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 5,
                                    vertical: 1,
                                  ),
                                  constraints: const BoxConstraints(
                                    minWidth: 18,
                                    minHeight: 18,
                                  ),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: Colors.red.shade600,
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                      color: Colors.white,
                                      width: 1.5,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  child: Center(
                                    child: Text(
                                      unreadCount > 99 ? '99+' : '$unreadCount',
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        color: Colors.white,
                                        fontSize: 9,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                          ],
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      _t('welcome_back'),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 13,
                        color: AppColors.textLight,
                      ),
                    ),
                    Text(
                      _t('doctor_title'),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 18,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        color: AppColors.textDark,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 20),

            // الكارت الرئيسي
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: const LinearGradient(
                  colors: [Color(0xFF14C8B0), Color(0xFF0EA28E)],
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                ),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: AppColors.primary.withOpacity(0.25),
                    blurRadius: 15,
                    offset: const Offset(0, 8),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              _t('manage_lab_orders'),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white,
                                fontSize: 18,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 6),
                            Text(
                              _t('add_new_prosthetic_subtitle'),
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.white70,
                                fontSize: 12,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                      const Icon(
                        Icons.biotech_rounded,
                        size: 44,
                        color: Colors.white38,
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Align(
                    alignment: AlignmentDirectional.centerEnd,
                    child: ElevatedButton(
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                        foregroundColor: AppColors.primary,
                        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        ),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                          horizontal: 16,
                          vertical: 8,
                        ),
                        elevation: 0,
                      ),
                      onPressed: () async {
                        final result = await Navigator.push(
                          context,
                          MaterialPageRoute(
                            builder: (_) => const CreateOrderScreen(),
                          ),
                        );
                        if (result == true) {
                          _fetchOrders();
                        }
                      },
                      child: Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Text(
                            _t('add_order_btn'),
                            style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          const Icon(Icons.add, size: 18),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 24),

            // عنوان أحدث الطلبات
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Text(
                  _t('recent_orders'),
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 18,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: AppColors.textDark,
                  ),
                ),
                InkWell(
                  onTap: widget.onNavigateToOrders,
                  child: Text(
                    _tArgs('view_all_with_count', {
                      'count': '${_orders.length}',
                    }),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 13,
                      color: AppColors.primary,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            // القائمة المصغرة
            _isLoading
                ? const Center(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 40),
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                        color: AppColors.primary,
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : _orders.isEmpty
                ? Center(
                    child: Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 40),
                      child: Column(
                        children: [
                          const Icon(
                            Icons.inbox_rounded,
                            size: 48,
                            color: AppColors.textLight,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(
                            _t('no_orders_found'),
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              color: AppColors.textLight,
                              fontSize: 14,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : ListView.builder(
                    shrinkWrap: true,
                    physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                    itemCount: _orders.length > 5 ? 5 : _orders.length,
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final item = _orders[index];
                      final status = item['status'] ?? 'pending';
                      final int orderId = item['id'] ?? 0;

                      final statusColor = _getStatusColor(status);
                      final statusIcon = _getStatusIcon(status);

                      return InkWell(
                        onTap: () async {
                          final res = await Navigator.push(
                            context,
                            MaterialPageRoute(
                              builder: (_) =>
                                  OrderDetailsScreen(orderId: orderId),
                            ),
                          );
                          if (res == true) _fetchOrders();
                        },
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                        child: Container(
                          margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: Colors.white,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                            boxShadow: [
                              BoxShadow(
                                color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.04),
                                blurRadius: 12,
                                offset: const Offset(0, 4),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                          child: Row(
                            children: [
                              Container(
                                width: 50,
                                height: 50,
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: AppColors.accentMint,
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
                                ),
                                child: const Icon(
                                  Icons.medical_services_outlined,
                                  color: AppColors.primary,
                                  size: 26,
                                ),
                              ),
                              const SizedBox(width: 14),
                              Expanded(
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    Text(
                                      item['patient_name'] ??
                                          _t('order_placeholder'),
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 16,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                        color: AppColors.textDark,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                                    Text(
                                      item['prosthetic_type']?['name']
                                              ?.toString() ??
                                          _t('dental_prosthesis'),
                                      style: const TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                        color: AppColors.textLight,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  horizontal: 10,
                                  vertical: 4,
                                ),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color: statusColor.withOpacity(0.12),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                  border: Border.all(
                                    color: statusColor.withOpacity(0.3),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                                  children: [
                                    Icon(
                                      statusIcon,
                                      size: 14,
                                      color: statusColor,
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 4),
                                    Text(
                                      _getStatusTranslation(status),
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                        color: statusColor,
                                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                        fontSize: 12,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
